sources.title: Phi (language model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Phi is a series of large language models developed by Microsoft that are open-weights and can run locally on one's device. The initial version, Phi-1, released in June 2023. Phi-3 was released in April 2024. Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B was released in March 2026. The New York Times considered Phi-3-mini to be Microsoft's push into smaller large language models. sources.title: Announcing Phi-3 fine-tuning, new generative AI models, and other Azure ...
sources.snippet: Phi-3 models are our most capable and cost-effective small language models (SLMs) available, outperforming models of the same size and next size up. As developers look to tailor AI solutions to meet specific business needs and improve quality of responses, fine-tuning a small model is a great alternative without sacrificing performance.
